//compilerOptions: Deliberately empty, and it must stay present. tsconfig.json in this repo is
a leftover @tsconfig/strictest build config from the v1 commit (outDir
./public, rootDir ./src) — nothing runs tsc here any more, Deno is the only
toolchain. When deno.json declares no compilerOptions, Deno falls back to
reading tsconfig.json, which breaks the repo two ways: its
AppBase.ts cannot resolve ./feat/GridFeature.ts), and checkJs + the
strictest flags get applied to src/vendor/*.js. Declaring compilerOptions
here stops that fallback and puts type checking back on Deno's defaults —
which is exactly what consumers of this library already get, since they
resolve these modules over HTTP and never see this tsconfig.json.
//exclude: src/vendor/ is vendored third-party source (canvas-confetti 1.9.2, dat.gui
0.7.9) — never hand-edited, so it is excluded from lint and check as well
//lint: no-window is disabled because most of this repo is browser code (Debug,
Settings, feat/*) that ships to a real browser, where `window` is the
correct global. The rule only warns because deno lint assumes a Deno
runtime. Rewriting these to globalThis would be an edit to shipped
